Messages.Author: Peter D Bakija
Messages.Body:
When using inferior Revelations:

A) Can you choose to *not* make someone discard a card?

B) Do you get to see the card that gets redrawn by the discarded card
before the effect of the card ends?

Thanks,
-Peter

Messages.Author: Timlagor
Messages.Body:
Peter D Bakija expounded:

> When using inferior Revelations:
>
> A) Can you choose to *not* make someone discard a card?

No. It is a double-edged sword.

> B) Do you get to see the card that gets redrawn by the discarded card
> before the effect of the card ends?

No. (I asked this quite recently after someone insisted that they could
look at mine)
